The company focuses on premium spirits, including award-winning brandy and vodka, leveraging Ronald Isley's massive cultural influence and social media reach. The brand aims to disrupt the luxury alcohol market by combining high-quality distillation with celebrity lifestyle branding.

founders.name: Ronald Isley
founders.bio: Grammy-award winning lead vocalist of The Isley Brothers with over six decades in the entertainment industry.

updates.title: Strategic Expansion
updates.body: Expanding distribution for our premium brandy and spirits line across the US.

highlights: Co-founded by R&B legend Ronald Isley
Leverages 4.8 million combined social media followers
Award-winning spirits profile in the premium segment

name: Minds
tagline: The social network that you own
description: Minds is a decentralized social networking platform focused on Internet freedom, privacy, and user ownership. Unlike traditional social media, Minds rewards users with crypto tokens for their contributions and utilizes open-source software to ensure transparency. With a community of over 5 million members, it represents a leading alternative to centralized Big Tech platforms.

founders.name: Bill Ottman
founders.bio: Leading voice in alternative social media, featured on Joe Rogan, Wired, and NPR for his work on decentralization.

updates.title: 5 Million Members
updates.body: Reached a significant milestone of 5 million registered members on the decentralized platform.

highlights: Open-source codebase with a focus on free speech

name: Collab - 150 Panoramic
tagline: Bringing institutional-quality student housing opportunities to everyday investors.
description: Collab is a real estate investment platform specializing in institutional-quality student housing. Their featured property, 150 Panoramic Way, is a premium residential building located steps from the UC Berkeley campus. By leveraging a co-ownership model, the company allows everyday investors to access high-yield real estate assets traditionally reserved for institutional funds. The property is strategically positioned in a high-demand student market with consistent occupancy rates.

founders.name: Qian Wang
founders.bio: An alumnus of MIT and Harvard, spent 22 years building and operating $3.1 billion in real‑estate projects across China and the United States with top‑tier partners.

updates.title: Campaign Launch
updates.body: Collab launched its latest property-specific fundraise for 150 Panoramic Way, targeting institutional-grade student housing.

highlights: Property located steps from UC Berkeley
Managed by MIT/Harvard alum with $3B+ experience
Debt security offering with 2.0x-2.2x payback multiple

name: Wild Rye
tagline: Beautifully designed technical apparel to empower women in the outdoors and beyond.
description: Wild Rye is a premium outdoor apparel brand dedicated to creating high-performance technical gear specifically for women. Founded by industry veteran Cassie Abel, the company addresses the historical gap in the market for women's-first design in mountain biking and skiing. The brand is a certified B-Corp and has achieved significant retail penetration, securing placements in major outlets including REI, Title Nine, and Evo. They focus on sustainability, contemporary aesthetics, and inclusive sizing for active women.

founders.name: Cassie Abel
founders.bio: Cassie has worked in the outdoor industry for nearly 20 years. She is a 3x All-American lacrosse player turned adventure athlete and recognized outdoor industry leader.

updates.title: 300 Doors Milestone
updates.body: Wild Rye is now sold in every REI door and over 75 specialty retailers, totaling 300 locations nationwide.

highlights: Sold in every REI, Evo, and Title Nine location
Founder has 20 years of outdoor industry experience

name: Evolving Palate Inc.
tagline: “Best Casual Contemporary Indian Restaurant,” growing at 30% YOY.
description: Evolving Palate Inc. operates Desi, an award-winning contemporary Indian restaurant concept. Desi offers a modern take on traditional Indian street food and classics, positioned in the fast-growing casual dining segment. Since its opening in 2019, the brand has doubled its annual revenue and received critical acclaim for its unique flavor profiles and high-quality ingredients. The company is currently focused on scaling its successful restaurant model to new locations to meet high consumer demand.

founders.name: Mohit Nagrath
founders.bio: Recipient of 'Best Casual Contemporary Indian Restaurant' in Santa Clara County. Expert in hospitality and restaurant management.

updates.title: Revenue Growth
updates.body: Doubled annual revenue since 2019, now exceeding $1 million in trailing twelve-month sales.

highlights: Named Best Casual Contemporary Indian Restaurant in Santa Clara County
Proven unit economics in the competitive CA market

name: Battle Approved Motors
tagline: An elite, electric, off-road vehicle
description: Battle Approved Motors (BAM) is developing high-performance, electric off-road vehicles designed for extreme sports and utility. Their flagship R101 prototype is currently in production, targeting a niche market of off-road enthusiasts and professional racers. The company has already secured significant interest with over $16 million in pre-orders. BAM aims to combine extreme durability with zero-emission electric powertrains, positioning itself as a leader in the next generation of rugged transportation.

founders.name: Chris James
founders.bio: Creator and producer of 'Mod Kids USA' on Prime Video. Former professional BMX racer with deep roots in motorsports and extreme sports production.

updates.title: R101 Prototype Update
updates.body: The R101 prototype has entered production phase to fulfill a growing backlog of pre-orders.

highlights: Led by a veteran extreme sports producer and racer
Targeting the high-growth electric off-road vehicle sector

name: Plus.Fan
tagline: Working to redefine the future of fan engagement
description: Plus.Fan is a sports technology company providing a SaaS platform for teams to enhance fan engagement through artificial intelligence and interactive digital experiences. Since its launch, the platform has quickly expanded, signing 20 professional teams across eight countries and four different sports. Plus.Fan focuses on helping clubs monetize their global fanbases and improve retention through personalized content and data-driven insights. The company is scaling rapidly, averaging more than one new club signing per month.

founders.name: Steve Paris
founders.bio: Repeat founder with a focus on sports technology and fan interaction systems.

updates.title: International Expansion
updates.body: Plus.Fan has now signed 20 teams across 8 countries, maintaining a growth rate of over one club per month.

highlights: 20 teams signed across 8 countries and 4 sports
Averaging 1+ new club signing per month

name: SchoolRyde
tagline: Affordable & safe daily rides for kids - powered by smart taxi dispatch technology
description: SchoolRyde provides a safe and affordable daily transportation solution for K-12 students by leveraging smart taxi dispatch technology. By partnering with high-growth taxi fleets, the platform ensures reliable transit for children while offering parents peace of mind through vetted drivers and real-time tracking. The service integrates directly with existing local transportation infrastructure to scale rapidly across urban areas.

founders.name: Naveen Tulseela
founders.bio: Technical Advisor at Liscio and former Technologist at Docusign; University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign (UIUC) Alumni.

updates.title: Expansion of Fleet Partnerships
updates.body: Now partnered with high-growth taxi fleets comprising over 300 drivers each.

name: AspectAvy
tagline: App to help you avoid avalanches as you navigate the backcountry.
description: AspectAvy is a mobile safety application designed to prevent avalanche accidents for backcountry skiers and snowsports enthusiasts. Developed by certified IFMGA guides, the app uses predictive data and terrain analysis to help users identify high-risk areas before they enter them. By providing expert-level safety insights on a consumer-friendly interface, it aims to reduce fatalities in the wilderness.

founders.name: Jeff Banks
founders.bio: Certified IFMGA guide and avalanche survivor with over 20 years of experience teaching safety courses in Europe and the US.

updates.title: Beta Launch Complete
updates.body: Successfully raised $300k to complete beta testing and launch the MVP.

highlights: Significant user growth during winter beta
Critical safety tool for backcountry athletes

name: Iter Opus
tagline: How talent meets opportunity - AI career concierge and intelligent workforce platform
description: Iter Opus is an AI-driven workforce platform that functions as a career concierge, matching professional talent with the most relevant opportunities. The platform leverages intelligent algorithms to streamline recruitment and digital transformation in the HR sector. Managed by veterans of the tech industry, the platform focuses on long-term career growth rather than simple job placement.

founders.name: Andrew Dimock
founders.bio: Digital transformation expert with 28+ years of experience; former Visiting Lecturer at RIT and Co-Founder of Vessel Strategy.

updates.title: Campaign Launch
updates.body: Iter Opus goes live on Wefunder with backing from notable angel investors.

highlights: Focus on digital transformation in HR

name: Island Company Rum
tagline: A true ‘Luxury Rum’™ appealing to health-conscious escapists
description: Island Company Rum is a high-end spirits brand catering to the luxury resort market with a focus on clean, health-conscious production. The product is both sugar-free and gluten-free, designed to meet the demands of sophisticated consumers seeking premium experiences. Built as an extension of the established Island Company lifestyle brand, it utilizes a proven distribution model across elite tropical destinations.

founders.name: Spencer Antle
founders.bio: Founder of Island Company lifestyle brand; six-time Inc 5000 fastest-growing company leader and award-winning filmmaker.

updates.title: Scaling Luxury Relaunch
updates.body: Island Company Rum is executing a fully operational relaunch targeting the 5-star tropical resort market.

name: Fork N' Film
tagline: A movie-theater plus restaurant where you eat, drink and watch film in one cool experience.
description: Fork N' Film delivers an immersive cinema-dining experience that synchronizes gourmet multi-course meals with specific moments in films. The concept has seen explosive growth, generating over $22M in retail sales within its first two years of operation. With locations in major international hubs, the company is redefining the traditional movie theater model through high-engagement experiential hospitality.

founders.name: Nicholas Houston
founders.bio: Expert in experiential hospitality and AI; focuses on scaling the guest experience and strategic global partnerships.

updates.title: Global Footprint Milestone
updates.body: Reached 22 top international destinations with $22.9M in total retail sales to date.

name: URB Sciences
tagline: A "picks and shovels" supplier to the cannabis industry
description: URB Sciences is a specialized supplier providing essential infrastructure and agricultural technology to the cannabis sector. The company focuses on high-performance nutrients and cultivation solutions that improve crop yields and quality. As a profitable enterprise in a rapidly expanding market, URB Sciences positions itself as a critical B2B partner for industrial growers.

founders.name: Lou Elwell
founders.bio: Lou has been a co-founder, Director, and officer of three public companies. With over three decades of entrepreneurial experience, he is scaling URB as a leader in industrial agricultural supply.

updates.title: Profitable Growth Milestone
updates.body: The company successfully grew sales by 530% last year and maintains a profitable bottom line while expanding B2B partnerships.

Founder has experience leading three public companies
Strategic 'picks and shovels' position in the cannabis market

name: Gig Market
tagline: Reshaping how neighborhoods get work done with local labor
description: Gig Market (Hustlr, Inc.) is a localized labor marketplace designed to connect community members with reliable help for short-term tasks. The platform reduces the friction of hiring local help through a mobile-first interface and verified peer reviews. By focusing on organic growth and neighborhood density, the company aims to solve the inefficiency of the modern gig economy.

founders.name: Doug Nguyen
founders.bio: Marketplace veteran with 18+ years of experience and two successful e-commerce exits. Expert in building scalable digital platforms with low customer acquisition costs.

updates.title: 25,000 User Milestone

highlights: 25,000+ users acquired almost entirely through organic growth
Zero-to-low CAC model driven by neighborhood word-of-mouth
Founder has two prior successful e-commerce exits
Addressable market includes local services and peer-to-peer labor

name: Laundry Hero Inc
tagline: The "Uber" of laundry service for B2C and B2B clients
description: Laundry Hero is an app-based logistics platform that provides on-demand laundry and dry-cleaning services. Serving both residential and commercial clients, the platform optimizes pickup and delivery routes to provide a convenient, affordable solution to a universal chore. The company is currently scaling its commercial division with significant purchase orders.

founders.name: Steven Liotta
founders.bio: PharmD and MBA graduate with a focus on operational efficiency. Built Laundry Hero to disrupt the traditional laundromat model through mobile logistics.

updates.title: Explosive Quarterly Growth

highlights: $100k+ in commercial purchase orders secured in 90 days
Scalable model serving both B2C and B2B segments
Proprietary app platform for route and order management

name: Healthmonde
tagline: AI-powered global health platform for affordable treatment
description: Healthmonde is an AI-driven healthcare platform designed to democratize access to medical treatments globally. By leveraging artificial intelligence to optimize healthcare supply chains and patient matching, Healthmonde reduces costs significantly for patients. The platform bridges the gap between high-quality medical providers and underserved populations through telehealth and data-driven coordination.

founders.name: Onur Durmusoglu
founders.bio: Serial entrepreneur with three companies founded and two successful exits in the digital communication space. Former strategist for major organizations like Turk Telekom.

updates.title: Platform Promotion

highlights: Operating in a market growing at a 32.5% CAGR
Proprietary AI matching for medical treatment affordability
Founder has two prior successful exits
Dual focus on B2B and B2C health coordination

name: Big Guns Coffee and Farm
tagline: Indoor hydroponic coffee farms for retail giants
description: Big Guns Coffee and Farm is an innovative agriculture venture that utilizes indoor hydroponics to grow high-quality coffee beans. Founded by a veteran and his young daughter, the company aims to disrupt the coffee supply chain by growing fresh beans in the USA. They are currently preparing for a major retail launch across multiple national grocery chains.

founders.name: Timothy Johnson
founders.bio: Marine Corps Veteran, bestselling author, and motivational speaker. Timothy is applying military-grade logistics and resilience to revolutionize the coffee industry.

highlights: Planned 2025 launch in Walmart and Sprouts
Innovative indoor hydroponic coffee cultivation model
Direct-to-consumer and major retail distribution strategy
